messages:
sam: Heads-up — getting repeated fires for alert `inference-burst-delta` on dedicated-pool-7 since ~05:12 UTC. Spike lines up with the canary push. Lots of 429s in the backend but overall traffic low. Can we mute or relax the threshold for a short window while we investigate?
incidents-bot: Alert `inference-burst-delta` fired at 2026-03-17T05:12:11Z (18 events in 5m) — https://grafana.redwood.net/alerts/1823 :rotating_light:
jess: Where's the best dashboard to eyeball this? I can jump in.
sam: Grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.net/d/ops/inference-overview?var-pool=dedicated-pool-7. Key panels: request rate by status, p95/p99 latency, and forwarder errors. Query I used: `sum(rate(inference_requests_total{pool=\"dedicated-pool-7\"}[5m])) by (status)`
raj: Looks canary-ish. I see a label mismatch: canary requests were supposed to be `canary=true` but they hit prod route without label, so rule fired. Short-term: a 45m silence scoped to pool=dedicated-pool-7 is fine. Longer-term: exclude `job=canary` or require >=2 windows before firing. Also consider raising the threshold from 20rps -> 30rps for that pool.
kevin: I can create an Alertmanager silence. Prefer it scoped to the pool label. Example curl I use locally to create a silence (fill in times/creator):
```
curl -s -XPOST "https://alertmanager.prod.redwood/api/v2/silences" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AM_TOKEN" -d '\n{\n  "matchers": [{"name":"pool","value":"dedicated-pool-7","isRegex":false}],\n  "startsAt":"2026-03-17T05:12:00Z",\n  "endsAt":"2026-03-17T05:57:00Z",\n  "createdBy":"kevin",\n  "comment":"temp mute for canary-caused noise"\n}\n'
```
kevin: I'll scope it to `pool=dedicated-pool-7` for 45m and add note.
maya: @kevin pls also add a link to the PR/issue in the comment so we have traceability. Do not mute broadly.
kevin: Done — silence S-3892 created, ends 2026-03-17T05:57:00Z. Comment: "canary-related noisy fires — see issue #3824"
jess: Leaving a trace link for context: https://traces.redwood.net/trace/0a1b2c showing forwarder spikes 05:10-05:16, and logs: https://logs.redwood.net/goto/abcdef where you can filter `pool=dedicated-pool-7` and `status=429`.
sam: Thanks — I'll open the PR to: 1) fix canary labeling, 2) make alert require 2 consecutive 5m windows, and 3) propose threshold bump. Will tag eng-sre for review.
raj: Sounds good. For the alert rule change, please include before/after grafana panels and sample query results. I'll take the review once PR is up.
sam: One more ask: can we also add a runbook note on the alert to check canary tag and forwarder rollout status? Saves future back-and-forth.
kevin: Added runbook pointer in the alert comment to https://wiki.redwood.net/runbooks/inference-burst-delta.
incidents-bot: Silence S-3892 is active; will expire at 2026-03-17T05:57:00Z.
